Two people - aged 20 years old and 21 – were detained under Section Fourteen of the Criminal Justice Act earlier today by detectives attached to Ballymun Garda Station following searches carried out this morning across Dublin city centre.
They remain in custody for questioning tonight.
Detectives believe those involved may also live locally or within close proximity to each other.
Mr O'Conner's family said: "We would like everyone to respect our privacy at this time."
His funeral will take place tomorrow afternoon at St Mary’s Church in Finglas followed by burial at Glasnevin Cemetery.

A positive sentiment analysis (PSA) refers to an approach for analyzing textual data with respect to its positivity/negativity level. positive sentiment analysis is a technique that analyzes the emotional content of text. It can be used to identify and quantify opinions, emotions or sentiments expressed in written texts such as reviews, news articles etc., which are often subjective rather than objective.
Positive Sentiment Analysis
A positive sentiment analysis (PSA) refers to an approach for analyzing textual data with respect to its positivity/negativity level. This type of study has been widely applied across various domains including marketing research , social media analytics , customer service management among others . The main goal behind performing PSA studies lies within understanding how people perceive certain products/services/brands through their online interactions .
In order to achieve this aim effectively one needs access not only towards large amounts but also accurate datasets containing relevant information about users’ feelings regarding specific entities under investigation e.g brands/products/categories etc.. Once collected these sets must then undergo rigorous cleaning procedures before being fed into machine learning algorithms capable enough handling complex patterns present therein thus enabling us extract meaningful insights from them ultimately leading toward better decision making processes down stream!
Sentiments & Emotions: What’s Difference?
The terms “sentiment”and“emotion”, while closely related concepts have distinct meanings when it comes to psychology literature:
Emotion – An internal state characterized by physiological arousal accompanied by cognitive appraisal resulting either positively(pleasure), negatively(discomfort )or neutrally(neutral).
On other hand,Sentimentis definedas follows :It represents overall evaluation made upon some object based on personal experiences stored inside our minds over time;it could range anywhere between very negative (“I hate him”)to extremelypositive (“He saved my life”).This distinction becomes crucial since both words refer same thing at times yet differ significantly depending context usage !

Positive Sentiment Analysis
A positive sentiment analysis (PSA) refers to an approach for analyzing textual data with respect to its positivity/negativity level. This type of study has been widely applied across various domains including marketing research , social media analytics , customer service management among others . The main goal behind performing PSA studies lies within understanding how people perceive certain products/services/brands through their online interactions .
In order to achieve this aim effectively one needs access not only towards large amounts but also accurate datasets containing relevant information about users’ feelings regarding specific entities under investigation e.g brands/products/categories etc..
